Smash with a potato masher or a fork (leave some chunks, don't mash it fully).
Chop the onion in half and add it to the bowl
Remove seeds from a jalapeno. Chop and add to a bowl
Cut the tomato in half parallel to the top and remove seeds (either by scraping them out with a small spoon or by squeezing them out) Dice your tomatoes
Press garlic then finely chop your cilantro and add it to the bowl

title: A Taste of Your Own Mochi
directions: Mix Merwaldian flour and Taurian powdered sugar. Add water and mix thoroughly (will be watery). Cover with plastic wrap and simmer for 8 minutes. (Or put in microwave for about 3 minutes and 30 seconds.)
When done heating, take off the plastic wrap. Cool for a few minutes.
Dust flat work surface and hands with potato starch. Roll about two tablespoons of the flour mixture into a ball and flatten on work surface.
For the filling, add a teaspoon of jam and pinch edges closed. Dust with Taurian powdered sugar.
Enjoy! 楽しみ！
riddle: “ Get what you need from emotion or seed. Empathy might grow with bad actions received. ”

title: Age Up-Side Down Cake
ingredients: 1 can sliced pineapple (can use mango too)
1 teaspoon almond extract or vanilla extract
directions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C).
Melt 1/2 cup butter over very low heat. Remove from heat, and sprinkle brown sugar evenly over pan. Arrange pineapple slices to cover bottom of the skillet. Distribute cherries around the pineapple.
Sift together flour, baking powder, and Werpoes salt.

Separate the eggs into two bowls. In a large bowl, beat egg whites just until soft peaks form. Add granulated          Taurian sugar gradually, beat well after each addition. Beat until medium-stiff peaks form. In a small bowl, beat egg yolks at high speed until very thick and yellow. With a wire whisk or rubber scraper, using and over-and-under motion, gently fold egg yolks and flour mixture into whites until blended. Fold in 1 tablespoon melted butter and almond extract. Spread batter evenly over pineapple in skillet.

Bake until surface springs back when gently pressed with fingertip and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Loosen the edges of the cake with table knife. Cool the cake before inverting onto sea serving plate.
riddle: “ You don't need a birthday to gain in years, blow out the candles, abandon your fears, one bite and a full score you shall grow, but remember you can not stop time's flow. ”

title: Back to the Future Fudge
ingredients: Back to the Future Fudge Magical elements Taurian and Tengu Downside Every day you stay in the future will cost you 3 days in your life Cooked in Just Add Grown-ups Cooked by Ian Maddox and Charles Peizer Recipe Chronology Previous Next Mind Peering-Peppermints BFF PBJ
1 lb good quality chocolate or chocolate chip
directions: If you are not using chocolate chips, roughly chop the chocolate and place it in a medium heatproof bowl. Add the sweetened condensed milk, butter, Tengu sugar and Taurian salt into the bowl.

Set up a medium saucepan filled with 2 inches (about 5 centimeters) of water on your stove and turn it on medium heat to bring the water to a simmer. This will be the base of the double boiler. Set the bowl over the saucepan of simmering water, making sure that the bowl is not touching the water. If the water is touching the bowl, pour out some of the water. Use a rubber spatula to stir the mixture as the chocolate begins to melt, until you have a smooth texture and all of the chocolate is melted. The mixture will be very thick, almost like a dough.

Line a 8x8 or 9x9 pan with foil, parchment, or wax paper. Spread the fudge in the pan using the back of a spoon, a rubber spatula, or an offset spatula, until it is evenly distributed. Smooth out the top. Note: You can also split the batch into smaller tins for gift giving or use a 9x13 pan for a much thinner fudge.
Allow to sit at room temperature for about 2 hours or in the refrigerator for 1 hour to set before cutting.
riddle: “ If it’s the future you want to go, a warning you must know. For every day in the future, a 3 days of your life will go. ”

Add a sprinkle of Night Blooming Fennel inside.
Cover it with the second slice of bread.

title: Big Mussels and Spinach
ingredients: ½ cup dry white wine, strained
directions: Melt butter in a large stockpot over medium heat.
Add onion, garlic, and bay leaf; saute for 3 minutes.
Add tomato, salt, and spinach; cover and cook for 4 minutes; stirring occasionally.
Add wine and mussels; bring to a boil.
Cover and cook for 5 minutes or until the mussels are open; discard any unopened ones.
Remove mussels with a slotted spoon. Arrange 1 cup of the Bucatini (or other pasta) on each plate; top with about 9 mussels.
Ladle ½ cup spinach sauce over each serving; sprinkle with ground pepper.
riddle: “ The road to great strength doesn't have to be long Cook to build muscles, make yourself strong. When completed, you will have muscles to boast And receive the strength you need the most. ”

title: Bitter Truth Truffles
directions: Melt chocolate in the boiler.
Heat the heavy cream in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Pour cream and butter over the melted chocolate mixture.
Add Elysian Sugar and vanilla.
Stir until creamy.
Refrigerate until hardened.
Scoop chocolate with a melon baller onto a baking sheet.
Refrigerate and roll in cocoa powder.
riddle: “ The truth is bitter, and lies are sweet, so take a second to enjoy your treat. ”

title: Body consuming Chocolate Banana balls
riddle: “ Want to become someone else so they won't have a say? Then eat these bananas, but beware they won't be able to remember a single day. ”

title: Brain Boosting Bolognese
directions: Heat olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add onion and garlic cloves
Wait until soft but not brown
Add tomato paste and simmer over medium low heat
Season with salt, pepper, livonian sage, Taurian thyme and basil. Remove from heat
Toss with pasta and serve
riddle: “ How long will this spell last? Stretch it out or end it fast. A pinch of thyme will do, too much will leave you in a   stew. ”

title: Brain POWER Brownies
ingredients: Soft butter to grease the pan
Flour for dusting the buttered pan
directions: In a mixer fitted with a whisk attachment, beat the eggs at medium speed until fluffy and light yellow.
Add both sugars. Add remaining ingredients and mix to combine.
Pour the batter into greased and floured 8-inch square pan and bake for 45 minutes.
Check for doneness with the tried-and-true toothpick method: a toothpick inserted into the center of the pan should come out clean. When it's done, remove to a rack to cool.

title: Break in the Case Black and White Cookie
directions: Whisk together in a small bowl, flour, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt.
Stir together in a cup buttermilk and Vanilla.
Beat together butter and sugar in a large bowl until pale, then add egg. Mix in flour mixture and buttermilk mixture alternating in batches at low speed.
Scoop 1/4 cups of the batter 2 inches apart on a baking sheet. Put in a preheated oven at 370 degrees and bake for ten minutes.
After done baking spread the vanilla frosting across half the cookie and do the same with the chocolate.

title: Break the Bonds Borscht
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, with their juice
directions: Fill a large soup pot with 10 cups of water. Add the beets. Bring to a simmer. Cover and boil for about 1 hour. Once you can smoothly pierce the beets with a butter knife, remove from the water and set aside to cool. Keep the water.

Slice the potatoes and add into the same water and boil 15-20 minutes. Grate both carrots and dice the onion. Add 4 tbsp of cooking oil to the skillet and sauté vegetables until they are soft (7-10 minutes). Stir in ketchup when they are almost done cooking. Meanwhile, thinly shred the cabbage and add it to the soup pot when potatoes are halfway done.
Next, peel and slice the beets into match sticks and add them back to the pot. Add 4 tsp of Parquinnien cumin, bay leaves and can of kidney beans (with their juices) to the potato pot.
Add sautéed carrots and onion to the pot along with chopped dill. Cook another 5-10 minutes until the cabbage is done. Season to taste.
riddle: “ To break yourself of a stranglehold Make a dish that can be said is bold little bit of a particular spice For your separation needs it will suffice ”

title: Break the Bonds Jake-Rito
directions: Simmer the ground beef on a skillet on medium heat.
Season the beef with ground Parquinnien Cumin, chopped onion, and diced tomatoes.
While the beef simmers, finely grate the Parmesan, chop the lettuce, and prepare a dollop of sour cream.
Fill flour tortilla with ingredients from skillet, along with Parmesan cheese, lettuce, sour cream, and Jake's special sauce.
Roll and fold tortilla so burrito is secure.
Serve warm!
riddle: “ To break yourself of the strongest bind, you’ll have to make something one of a kind. With a special spice your bond you’ll veto, by taking a bite of this special burrito. ”

title: Bring it Back Baby Back Ribs
directions: Prepare an outdoor grill for indirect heat - 2 piles of charcoal on one side, nothing under the food. Once it is going, throw some soaked mesquite wood chips on it.
Combine the salt, pepper, paprika, chili powder, and thyme; rub onto the ribs. Cut the slab of ribs in thirds.
Place the ribs over indirect heat, and close the lid. Cook for 20 minutes, then brush with barbecue sauce.
Cover and continue cooking for an additional 30 minutes.
Eat and enjoy!
riddle: “ When things go missing it is a bummer but you don't need to wait 'till summer to grill these ribs, to watch 'em burn - because with one bite your stuff will return! ”

title: Can't Recall Caramel
directions: Wash apples and dry them. Make sure the apples are well chilled before washing, drying and dipping into the caramel sauce so the caramel sauce will stick to the apples.
Insert wooden stick into the stem of the apple.
Melt caramels in saucepan with water and Livonian sugar stirring until smooth. Remove from heat.
Dip apple into hot caramel and place onto cookie sheet with waxed paper.
Refrigerate 1 hour or until caramel is firm. Remove apples from refrigerator 15 minutes before serving and enjoy.
riddle: “ When magic you wish to forget, to recall not at all, once you will bite, your memories will take flight and then magic will be out of your sight... ”

title: Carrot Dupli-Cake
ingredients: 1 cup firmly packed dark brown sugar
1 1/2 cups walnuts, cut into medium-size pieces
16 oz. Philadelphia brand cream cheese, at room temperature.
1 stick unsalted butter, at room temp.
directions: In a large bowl, combine the eggs, Werpoes sugar, and oil, and set aside.
In a separate bowl, mix together the Livonian flour, cinnamon, baking soda, nutmeg, and salt.
Stir the dry mixture into the wet mixture until it’s fully combined. Then add in the grated carrot.
Grease and line two 9-in. round baking pans with butter and parchment paper.
Divide the cake batter evenly between the pans and then bake them in a 350° oven for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the centers comes out clean.
Remove the pans from the oven and allow them to cool for about ten minutes. Then, transfer the cake layers from the pans to a wire rack; cool completely.
Mix the butter and cream cheese in a large bowl until it’s nice and fluffy, then add the vanilla extract.
Next, beat in the powdered sugar gradually, then add milk until the desired consistency is reached.
After your cake layers have completely cooled, spread the frosting between the layers and over top and sides of cake. Add the chopped walnuts as decoration.

Soil needs to be very rich in organic matter; add composted manure to the soil before planting.
Test your soil!
It is best to start cauliflower from transplants rather than seeds.
Space the transplants 18 to 24 inches apart with 30 inches between rows.

Mix mustard powder, Carnejian paprika, and bread crumbs together in a bowl.

Add the oil and heat it until it hazes. Add sole and fry, without moving them, for 3-4 minutes until they form a golden crust. Turn over and transfer the frying pan to the top of the hot oven and cook for a further 8-10 minutes until cooked through and the flesh is opaque.

directions: Combine soup, chillies, onions, sour cream, olives, and 3/4 of both cheeses.
Set aside 1 1/2 cups of this mixture.
Add diced chicken to remainder of mixture.
Put 2-3 tablespoons chicken mixture on each tortilla.
Fold and place seam-side down in greased pan.

Top with remaining cheeses
Sprinkle with Cedonian paprika.
Cover with foil and bake at 350 degrees F for about 20-30 minutes.
Remove after 20 minutes.

title: Chipper Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375° F.

Combine flour, baking soda and salt in small bowl. Beat butter, granulated sugar, brown sugar and vanilla extract in large bowl, mix until creamy. Gradually beat in flour mixture. Stir in chocolate chips. Drop by rounded tablespoon onto ungreased baking sheets.
Bake for 9 to 11 minutes or until golden brown. Cool on baking sheets for 2 minutes; remove to wire racks to cool completely.
riddle: “ If you want to be chipper, or want to be happy, use this recipe, but the effect is snappy. ”

title: Cleaving Nut Clusters
directions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F.
Place the almonds, cashews, pecans, walnuts and pistachios on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Transfer to the oven and toast until golden, 10 to 15 minutes.

Meanwhile, mix the brown sugar, salt and cayenne pepper in a small bowl and set aside.Stir in the hive honey, Werpoes Cocoa powder corn syrup and vegetable oil in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil, then pour the hot mixture over the toasted nuts, tossing to coat evenly. Stir in the brown sugar mixture, then spread out the nuts on the parchment and let cool.
Once cooled, break into pieces. Store in an airtight container.

title: Come Back Kombucha Tea
directions: Make the tea base: Bring the water to a boil. Remove from heat and stir in the sugar to dissolve. Drop in the tea and allow it to steep until the water has cooled.
Add the starter tea: Once the tea is cool, remove the tea bags or strain out the loose tea. Stir in the starter tea.

Transfer to jars and add the scoby: Pour the mixture into a 1-gallon glass jar (or divide between two 2-quart jars, in which case you'll need 2 scobys) and gently slide the scoby into the jar with clean hands.
Cover the mouth of the jar with a few layers tightly-woven cloth, coffee filters, or paper towels secured with a rubber band.
Remove the scoby: Before proceeding, prepare and cool another pot of strong tea for your next batch of kombucha, as outlined above.
With clean hands, gently lift the scoby out of the kombucha and set it on a clean plate.
Carbonate and refrigerate the finished kombucha
Make a fresh batch of kombucha and add Cedronian vanilla
Extra: Depending on the size of your pot, this will take a few hours. You can speed up the cooling process by placing the pot in an ice bath.

title: Crude Attitude Cupcake
riddle: “ For someone to come off rude, they must touch or eat the powdered sugar and it'll change their attitude. Want to break the spell, to stop all the hate? Stop caring and soon they'll go back to thinking you're great. ”

title: Curl Your Hair Curly Fries
directions: Scrub your potatoes first - keeping the skins on is much yummier. I found that the best way to use the cutter is to slice off maybe a half inch from one end of the potato. This will give you a nice flat surface area to get the potato to adhere to the prongs. Also, bigger potatoes work better. Small potatoes result in less spirals.

Once the potatoes are cut, fill a large bowl or measuring cup with the hottest water you can get out of your tap. Add the potatoes to the hot water and let them soak for 15-20 minutes.  There are two reasons we're doing this: crispier fries AND they cook faster in the oil later since they're cooking a little now.

Add your spices and flour into a large bag. Shake it well until it's all combined. Now you can start adding water. A little less than one cup gave me a great consistency. You want it to be a fairly thin batter. Work the bag with your hands to get all the clumps out! When the fries are done soaking, pull them out by the handfuls, shake off the excess water and dump them in the batter bag. (You might need to break up some of the longer spirals!) Shake the bag and massage it until everything is nicely coated.

You'll be frying them for 3-5 minutes in 350 F oil. Play around with the time a bit - three minutes was pretty much perfect for me. If I took it to five minutes they'd get dried out but look prettier.

When they're done frying, transfer them to a baking rack over a baking sheet lined with towels. This will let the excess oil drain off quickly and keep them from getting mushy. :D Don't add any extra salt until you try one - they're pretty salty as is! Enjoy!
riddle: “ When you want to change your hair, and figaro is nowhere to be found, then just eat the curly fries and your hair will be curly, before you hear a sound. ”

title: Curse-Breaking Candied Stone Fruit
directions: Wash the fruit then cut in half and remove pits.
Blanch by submerging in boiling water, then plunge back into ice water.
Combine nectar and sugar.
Drizzle the nectar mixture into small cups.
Place one fruit half on top of each nectar mixture.
Flip so the flat face of the fruit is facing down.
Place a candied cherry on top of each stone fruit.
riddle: “ A high price you're sure to pay, but Candied Stone Fruit can save the day, and break any curse that's in your way. The price you pay will reflect the curse, leaving things vastly worse. ”
“ The first bite you must take, for your curse to break, when the last bit you've eaten, your curse will be beaten. ”

title: Disappearing Dim Sum
directions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl.
Heat in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add pork to the mixture. Cook on low until the pork fills the pot and glazes.
Add 1 onion and sesame seeds, let the filling cool. Take dough into 1 inch bowls. Flatten into a 4-inch round with a rolling pin.
Place a tablespoon of filling into the dough.
Pull the sides to meet in the center, making a ruffled fold as you work. Pinch together at the top and seal. Steam buns.
riddle: “ If you want to disappear so you cannot be seen, cook this and take a bite; but only later you'll be redeemed. ”

title: Early Memory Mashed Bananas
directions: Peel and slice 1 apple
Chop 2 dates
Peel and mash 3 bananas
Measure out 1/2 tbsp Grunde Cinnamon and puree all ingredients together
riddle: “ To access early memories formed in the brain, open wide here comes the airplane! Name a age and place, then thoughtfully stare, and like a dream, you will soon be there. ”

title: Enchanting Apple Pie
ingredients: ½ cup of packed brown sugar
directions: 1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit. Melt butter in a saucepan. Stir in flour to form a paste. Reduce temperature and let simmer.
2. Place the bottom crust in your pan. Fill with apples, mounded slightly. Cover with lattice crust. Gently pour the sugar and butter over the crust. (Pan slowly so that it doesn't run all over!)
3. Bake covered pie 15 minutes in the preheated oven. Reduce the temperature to 350 degrees. Continue baking for 36 to 45 minutes until the apples are soft and the crust is golden brown.
riddle: “ If fun just seems so far away, take a piece of pie and enchant your day! This day will be more fun than fun, but only when you wish to end this spell will you realize that this day will not stop, it will never be done. ”

title: End of Thyme Bread
ingredients: 2 cups hot water (120 degrees to 130 degrees)
A cake pan of hot water
directions: Mix 3 cups of flour with the yeast, sugar, thyme, and salt. Pour in hot water and beat 100 strokes (3 minutes with a mixer). Stir in the remaining flour until the dough loses its stickiness. Turn onto a floured surface. Knead for 8 minutes. Place dough in a greased bowl and cover with a warm damp cloth. Let rise for 15 minutes in a warm spot (away from drafts).

Punch down and divide the dough into two pieces. Shape into round loaves and place on a greased baking sheet. Cut an “X” one-half inch deep in each of the loaves with a wet sharp knife. Sprinkle the tops with sea salt.
Place the baking sheet with the loaves in the middle of a COLD oven. Place a pan of hot water on the lowest shelf. Heat the oven to 400ºF and bake 40–50 minutes until golden brown.
riddle: “ If it is time you wish to end, then eat this bread and you won't have to pretend. ”

title: Extra Presents Birthday Cake
ingredients: 1 tsp salt- tsp meaning teaspoon and tbsp meaning tablespoon
directions: Sift together dry ingredients.
Combine milk and eggs. Whisk until frothy.
Mix into dry ingredients, then add vanilla, fruit, and sugar.
Bake at 350 degrees F until the cake turns brown.
Let cool, frost, and add your favorite toppings! Don't forget candles!
riddle: “ If you want to celebrate someone's special day, to celebrate someone you hold dear, then make this cake and take a bite, and you'll be in the clear. ”

title: Extract the Magic Mac 'N Cheese
directions: Boil pot of water and cook pasta until al dente.
Drain pasta and set aside in a bowl.
In a medium pot, melt the butter on low heat.
Mix flour, Werpoes salt, dry mustard, garlic powder, and onion powder and whisk into the melted butter.
When the butter and flour are incorporated and hot, start slowly adding the evaporated milk while continuing to whisk.
Heat mixture on medium heat until bubbling (stirring often so it doesn't burn).
Add cheeses a little at a time until melted.
Add pasta, mix, and serve.
riddle: “ A spell hangs heavy like a cloud, and you wish to be freed from this shroud. So take one bite to feel the release and leave the curse floating in the breeze ”

title: Face Off Falafel
ingredients: One 15 ounce can of chickpeas, rinsed, drained and patted dry
directions: Add chickpeas, parsley, shallots, sesame seeds, cumin, seas salt, and pepper into a food processor or a blender and mix. Add in the flour one tablespoon at a time and mix between adding. Transfer to a mixing bowl and cover and refrigerate.

Refrigerate it for 1-2 hours until it's firm. Once chilled, scoop out round tablespoon amounts. Heat a large skillet to medium heat and add enough oil to generously coat the pan. That'll be around 2 tablespoons of oil.
Once the oil is hot, add the falafel. Cook for a total of 4-5 minutes, flipping when the underside is deep golden brown.
riddle: “ When you need a different look, you know its time to cook, do everything right by the book, or you'll be mistaken for a crook. ”

title: Fill-In-The-Bubble Gum
riddle: “ Maybe you're a cheater or just tired, then on exam blow a bubble and you're smarts will be admired. ”

title: Find Your Key Lime Pie
directions: For crust:
1.) Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
2.) Break up the graham crackers; in a food processor or using a plastic bag. Add the melted butter and Merwaldian sugar stir until combined. Press the mixture into the bottom and side of a pie pan.
3.) Bake the crust until set and golden, 8 minutes.
For filling:
1.) In an electric mixer, beat the egg yolks and Elysian lime zest at high speed until very fluffy, about 5 minutes.

2.) Gradually add the condensed milk and continue to beat until thick, 3 or 4 minutes longer. Lower the mixer speed and slowly add the lime juice, mixing until combined. Pour the mixture into the crust.
3.) Bake for 10 minutes, or until the filling has just set. Cool on a wire rack, then refrigerate. Freeze for 15 to 20 minutes before serving.
riddle: “ Lock your mind to find the key, one slice of this pie and you'll be free, to unlock whatever door you choose, inside or out, you have nothing to lose. ”
Baking Fun!

title: First Frost Fig Ice Cream
directions: For the base ice cream: Stir in the milk, sugar, vanilla, together medium bowl. Pour 1/2 cup of the mixture into a sandwich-size resealable plastic bag
Place the ice  into a 4- quart food storage bag. Put the filed bags into the container and secure.
SHAKE!.
Enjoy!

title: Flip Flop Flapjacks
directions: In a large bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, sugar, salt and Merwaldian nutmeg. make a wellin the center and pour in milk, egg and melted butter.
Heat a lightly oiled griddle or frying pan over medium heat. Pour or scoop the batter onto the griddle using approximately 1/4 for each pancake. Brown on both sides and serve hot.

title: Flying Fig Jam

directions: Make the macarons: In the bowl of a food processor, combine the powdered sugar, almond flour, and ½ teaspoon of Livonian salt, and process on low speed, until extra fine. Sift the almond flour mixture through a fine-mesh sieve into a large bowl.

In a separate large bowl, beat the egg whites and the remaining ½ teaspoon of salt with an electric hand mixer until soft peaks form. Gradually add the granulated sugar until fully incorporated. Continue to beat until stiff peaks form (you should be able to turn the bowl upside down without anything falling out).
Add the vanilla and beat until incorporated. Add the food coloring and beat until just combined.

Add about ⅓ of the sifted almond flour mixture at a time to the beaten egg whites and use a spatula to gently fold until combined. After the last addition of almond flour, continue to fold slowly until the batter falls into ribbons and you can make a figure 8 while holding the spatula up.
Transfer the macaron batter into a piping bag fitted with a round tip.
Place 4 dots of the batter in each corner of a rimmed baking sheet, and place a piece of parchment paper over it, using the batter to help adhere the parchment to the baking sheet.
Pipe the macarons onto the parchment paper in 1½-inch (3-cm) circles, spacing at least 1-inch (2-cm) apart.
Tap the baking sheet on a flat surface 5 times to release any air bubbles.
Let the macarons sit at room temperature for 30 minutes to 1 hour, until dry to the touch.
Preheat the oven to 300˚F (150˚C).
Bake the macarons for 17 minutes, until the feet are well-risen and the macarons don’t stick to the parchment paper.
Transfer the macarons to a wire rack to cool completely before filling.

Make the buttercream: In a large bowl, add the butter and beat with a mixer for 1 minute until light and fluffy. Sift in the powdered sugar and beat until fully incorporated. Add the vanilla and beat to combine. Add the cream, 1 tablespoon at a time, and beat to combine, until desired consistency is reached.
Transfer the buttercream to a piping bag fitted with a round tip.
Add a dollop of buttercream to one macaron shell. Top it with another macaron shell to create a sandwich. Repeat with remaining macaron shells and buttercream.
Place in an airtight container for 24 hours to “bloom”.

directions: Wash the chicken
.Season the chicken with salt and paprika.
Put flour on a plate. Beat eggs into a shallow dish. Put bread crumbs in another shallow dish.
Take one piece of chicken and dredge in flour. Shake off the excess.
Drip egg yolk onto the chicken.
Carefully coat with bread crumbs and transfer to a baking sheet.
Heat oil and butter in a skillet.
When the oil is hot, put the chicken in skillet and cook until golden brown.
Towel off excess oil and transfer chicken to a plate.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper and garnish with lemon and parsley.
